customers.evidence: Give customers a good, fair deal – offer high-quality, competitively priced products and services

employees.evidence: Provide our employees with the truth, opportunities, training, meaningful work and a commitment to build a healthy, vibrant company

dei.evidence: Recognize that we gain strength from a diverse workforce – embrace our differences

community.evidence: Leverage our success in order to give back to the communities where we do business

shareholders.evidence: We Will Always Maintain a Fortress Balance Sheet

integrity.evidence: At JPMorgan Chase, acting with integrity is paramount– and it applies to every aspect of our company.

innovation.evidence: Strive for continual improvement – drive change and innovation and never stop learning

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational and directive: many imperative bullets (Treat, Be, Ensure) and first-person plural promises. Customers and employees lead the headings. Hedged in places: 'We cannot promise specific outcomes or risk-free results', then 'What we can and will promise is to be truthful'. Distinctive phrasing like 'fierce resolve' and 'Keep one set of books'.
